Name: Farmer's Thoughts - Immersive Notification Bubbles
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=6]Farmer's Thoughts[/size][/center]
[center][i]Little messages, big thoughts.[/i][/center]
[center]Ever wished those little Stardew Valley notifications felt more like something your farmer was actually thinking?[/center]
[center]Well, now they can![/center]

[center][b]Farmer's Thoughts[/b] takes those familiar notifications from the corner of your screen and turns them into cute pixel-art thought bubbles that follow your farmer around. Whether you're picking up items, exploring the mines, discovering somewhere new, or just having one of those days, your farmer has a little something on their mind. [/center]

[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b]
[b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b]
[b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/size][/color][/center]



[b]🤔 What It Does[/b]
[list]
[*]Thought bubbles! Standard Stardew Valley notifications and compatible mod messages appear above your farmer instead of in the usual HUD corner.[/*]
[*]First-Person Thoughts - Messages like "You feel happy!" can become "I feel happy!", making them feel a little more personal.[/*]
[*]Live item pickups - Collect several of the same item and watch the quantity update in one bubble.[/*]
[*]Original icons - Keeps the familiar notification icons and important information.[/*]
[*]Gentle animations - A little pop when a thought appears, followed by a soft fade.[/*]
[*]Follows your farmer - Adjusts to camera movement, Zoom Level and UI Scale.[/*]
[*]Easy customisation - Adjust bubble size, reading time and first-person wording through GMCM.[/*]
[/list]

🧩 [b]THE PERFECT COMPANION TO MY OTHER MODS[/b]
This was a big reason I wanted to make Farmer's Thoughts.
I've been creating little mods that add more personality, challenges and everyday experiences to Stardew Valley.
But I started noticing something.
[b]All these mods tell your farmer things. What if your farmer could actually think about them?[/b]

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52335]Moody Farmer[/url], your farmer wakes up with different feelings, moods and challenges.
Now those little mood messages can feel like their own thoughts.

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52959]Farmer's End[/url], the deeper you venture into the mines, the more dangerous things become.
And when the monsters start hunting you, those warnings can feel a lot more personal.

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52511]Soap & Scrub[/url], your farmer notices when they're feeling fresh and clean.

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52587]When Nature Calls[/url], even those rather unfortunate bathroom emergencies become part of your farmer's day.
And the same idea works with notifications from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52632]Oops![/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52548]Time Chapter[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54078]Along the Way[/url].

Different mods. Different experiences. One little farmer with plenty on their mind.
[b]Farmer's Thoughts doesn't require any of my other mods.[/b] It works perfectly well on its own with vanilla Stardew Valley, too.
But if you enjoy using several of them together, I think Farmer's Thoughts is a lovely finishing touch.


[b]💭 WHY I MADE FARMER'S THOUGHTS[/b]
I really like those little notification messages in Stardew Valley.
But they're easy to overlook.
And with all the other mods I've been making, there are even more of these little moments happening throughout the day.
I wanted them to feel connected to the farmer instead of just appearing somewhere on the screen.

Nothing complicated.

Just a little bubble that makes you think, [i]"Oh, that's what my farmer is thinking right now."[/i]
That's really all Farmer's Thoughts is about.

[b]Same little messages. A little more personality.[/b]



[b]📦 REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu - Optional[/*]
[/list]
[b]💡 COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Farmer's Thoughts is a standalone mod and doesn't require any of my other mods to function.
It works with Stardew Valley's standard HUD notifications and compatible mod-generated notifications using the same game systems.
Additional compatibility support includes The Muttering Farmer, UI Info Suite 2 Alternative, Simple Location Display and zoom-related rendering behaviour.
Other mods that draw their own independent notification interfaces may continue showing those messages normally unless a specific integration is supported.
First-Person Thoughts uses programmed English grammar rules rather than live AI generation. Ambiguous messages and unsupported languages retain their original wording.
Because everyone's mod setup is different, I can't guarantee every notification system or unusual UI combination will behave perfectly. If you encounter something strange, feel free to report it.

[b]🤖 AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The AI-Generated Content tag reflects AI assistance during development, including programming and production of final visual assets from designs and visual direction created and approved by me.
Farmer's Thoughts was conceived, designed, directed, tested and approved by me.
The released mod does not use an AI model, online AI service or generative system while Stardew Valley is running. First-person wording, notification handling and thought-bubble presentation use programmed rules included with the mod.
It does not generate or rewrite other mods' source files or authored dialogue.
